藏品名称_EN: Copper with blue and white flowers and eight-sided candlestick
藏品名称_ZN: 青花折枝花纹八方烛台
描述_EN: Blue and white eight-square candlestick with folding flower design，Ming Yongle (1408-1466), reign name of Qing dynasty (1468-1466)，your (honorific)38.5centimetre，caliber9centimetre，footsteps23.5centimetre。collection of old treasures from the Qing dynasty。　　Candlesticks for eight ways，Upper and lower levels。Top and bottom are waisted octagonal，hollow inside the base。The upper pedestal is depicted from top to bottom with banana leaf motifs.、stripe、variegated lotus pattern。The pillars between the two tiers of pedestals are decorated with brocade and entwined floral patterns.。Lower pedestal seat with seawater river cliff pattern，Rim decorated with lotus petal pattern for one week，Eight groups of entwined flowers on eight sides of the outer wall。Blue and white color，feel faint，localized“ferruginous scar”。White glaze, rich and clear，unglazed。　　As early as the Three Kingdoms and the two Jin dynasties，Porcelain candlesticks appeared in China，Such as the sheep-shaped candlestick from the Three Kingdoms period、Candlesticks and other candlesticks with orcs from the two Jin dynasties，Lotus-shaped candlesticks were prevalent during the Northern and Southern Dynasties.，The bases of candlesticks from the Sui and Tang dynasties are often beautifully engraved with floral motifs.，In the Ming Dynasty, the eight-sided candlestick was popular.。The green material used for the decoration of this eight-square candlestick is imported cobalt.，so-called“Su Nai Bok Ching”（maybe“Soma Lei Ching (Chinese medicine)”）。The shape of this candlestick is modeled after the bronze candlesticks used in mosques in West Asia.。Copper candlesticks were popular in ancient Egypt and Syria.。
描述_ZN: Large dish with blue and white floral motifs, 8.5 cm high, 45.7 cm in diameter, 26.9 cm in foot.　　The dish has an open mouth, a folded rim, an arched belly, a footrim, and a fine sandy foot in flint red. The entire body is covered with white glaze and painted with blue and white floral motifs inside and out. The folding rim is painted with a week of 18 chrysanthemums. The inner abdomen is painted with a pattern of entwined pomegranates, chrysanthemums and peonies. The center of the plate is painted with a branch of lotus flower, surrounded by four groups of ruyi-headed cloud patterns, and within each cloud pattern is painted with a folded chrysanthemum pattern, and the cloud patterns are connected by intertwined patterns. The outer belly of the plate is painted with eight entwined chrysanthemum flowers and lotus petals.　　This plate is heavy body, the form is complete, reflecting the style and level of porcelain production in the Hongwu period. The painted floral decoration is smooth and vibrant, especially in the heart of the plate of the folding lotus, with a light and elegant flavor. This bold and dashing, sparse and dense decorative style fully demonstrates the characteristics of early Ming blue and white art.
